# components

**In one sentence:** small reusable UI pieces shared by many screens: the modal (pop-up dialog) layer and the "keep / reject" review card.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `modal.js` | `showModal(inner, {onBackdrop})` puts a dialog into the shared `#modalLayer`; `closeModal()` hides it; `modalCancelButton(onSubmitted)` makes the "Cancel run" button used by mid-run pauses. |
| `modal.css` | Styles the dim backdrop and two fixed-size dialog tiers: `.modal` (large, for reviews) and `.modal--compact` (forms and confirms). |
| `review_card.js` | `reviewCard(item, decisions, options)` builds an image card whose decision buttons, right-click cycling, and CSS class stay in sync with a shared `decisions` map; `syncReviewCards` repaints many cards at once. |

## How it works
- Only one modal is visible at a time; `showModal` replaces whatever was there.
- At most one backdrop-click listener exists; it is removed on the next show/close so it cannot close a later dialog by mistake.
- `modalCancelButton` calls `cancel_job`, closes the modal, then calls the poll callback so the UI shows the cancelled state.
- `reviewCard` writes the chosen value to `decisions[item.path]`, adds it as a CSS class, and sets `aria-pressed` on the buttons.

## Who uses it
- `modal.js`: nearly every step modal in `steps/*`, plus `library/modal.js` and `settings/settings.js`.
- `review_card.js`: `steps/source_review/card.js`, `steps/vae_review/components/card.js`, `steps/upscale_review/components/card.js`, `steps/caption_verify/components/strip.js`.
- `modal.css`: imported by `styles.css`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/modal.test.js`.
